html:
News Digest:

Over half of 111 institutional investors surveyed recently by virtual data room provider SS&C Intralinks have revealed an increase in capital allocation to private credit over the last three years, with 59% planning to boost their exposure to the asset class further in the next 36 months.

 

Takeaway:

The respondents, 60% of whom manage over $1bn in assets, remain also pretty buoyant about the overall debt capital markets, with the average portfolio allocations to this segment jumping from 16% in early 2021 to 36% this year, the survey found.

 

 

End Notes
Source: https://www.institutionalinvestor.com/article/b1wqk523lw42y5/Investors-Appear-Poised-to-Continue-Private-Credit-Allocations-Data-Shows
